messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #18412 is stuck in the merge queue because mac-integ shard3 keeps failing intermittently on TestKVEvict. I can't repro locally. Buildkite link: https://buildkite.example.com/builds/12345 :frowning:
ryan: Ugh. I saw a couple of flakes like that earlier today, might be the kv-cache eviction timing. Logs show a timeout in eviction.go: `evicter: timeout after 5s`
li: Is the failure deterministic on one shard? I see it only on mac-integ-3 in the last two runs.
sam: We have 2 approvers needed. If we do a targeted rerun and it passes, can someone second-approve? I don't want to hold the release.
maya: Plan suggestion: 1) targeted rerun for mac-integ-3 2) if rerun fails, start a bisect across last 10 commits 3) fallback: snapshot update if flaky assertion is snapshot-related.
ci-bot: buildkite: rerun triggered by maya for job mac-integ-3 — build 12347 queued. Command: `./scripts/ci rerun --job mac-integ-3 --pr 18412`
ryan: I'll watch the rerun. If it passes, @alex can you give the second approval? You reviewed earlier.
alex: Sure, happy to eyeball and approve if rerun is green. Quick check: any test-only changes in this PR? I only saw refactors to kv evict scheduling.
maya: No snapshot edits in this PR. Small refactor + a defensive nil-check.
sam: Rerun started — looks like mac-integ-3 is running. If it fails again we'll kick off a bisect, I'll prepare a bisect job (parallelize with 4 workers).
li: If bisect hits different commits on different flakes, try focusing on commits that touch kv/cache or timing constants.
ryan: Rerun is green :tada: (build 12347). Can we get an approval so this can merge in the next merge window?
alex: I reviewed quick diff, looks safe. :thumbsup: Approving now.
maya: Thanks — re-requesting merge. sam, any follow-ups to file for flaky telemetry? We should track if this resurfaces.
sam: I'll open a follow-up ticket to add a reproducible stress test and add a small latency buffer. Also adding a flaky label and linking logs.
ci-bot: buildkite: PR #18412 merged by alex — merge time 1717010050
